title: M11 · Downloads
question: The Downloads page for offline viewing. All three share the same rest: a Download button on title pages (this episode, the season, next 3 unwatched, or keep N unwatched downloaded), Original or a smaller converted copy, files in Movies ▸ Mezzanine, and an offline Home that shows only what's downloaded. This picks how the page itself works. Lock one, steer it, or re-roll.

options.label: By Title
options.lineage: Music's album/track split, applied to shows and films
options.thesis: A list of downloaded titles on the left; the selected title on the right with its episodes, sizes and its keep rule.
materials: title list with posters and size
detail pane: episodes, progress, keep rule
options.viewport: Left (300 pt): every downloaded title, poster thumb, name, "6 episodes · 4.2 GB", a thin progress line while downloading. Right: the selected title's backdrop strip, its episodes as rows (play, size, quality, status, remove), and the rule "Keep the next 3 unwatched episodes" as a pop-up. Header: "38 GB on this Mac · 112 GB free".
options.risk: Two panes for what may be a handful of files; a one-film download still opens a detail pane.

options.label: Queue and Shelf
options.lineage: Safari's Downloads list over a library grid
options.thesis: What's downloading sits on top as rows you can pause; everything ready waits below as posters you play.
materials: queue rows with progress and pause
options.viewport: Header: "Downloads" and "38 GB on this Mac · 112 GB free". Downloading: one 56 pt row per file (thumb, title, "S2 E4 · 1.1 of 2.3 GB · 3 min left", pause, cancel). Below, On This Mac: the posters grid (same cards as libraries, with a size line), shows grouped as one poster with "6 episodes". Selecting a show poster opens its page with the downloaded episodes marked.
options.risk: The queue empties most of the time, so the page is usually just a grid; keep rules live on title pages, not here.

options.label: Storage First
options.lineage: System Settings ▸ Storage, with the films as the bars
options.thesis: The page is about space: a large meter of what Mezzanine holds, then every title as a bar sized by its gigabytes, watched ones flagged to clear.
options.viewport: Top: a full-width meter (Mezzanine's downloads, other, free) with "38 GB of 512 GB". Below: one row per title, sorted by size, each with its poster thumb, name, episodes and a proportional bar; watched titles carry "Watched" and a Clear Watched button removes them all. In-flight downloads show as growing bars.
options.risk: Treats downloads as a cleanup chore; less inviting as a place to start watching offline.

regions.label: titles by size · bars · Clear Watched
